message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live calls to the VirusTotal API from here, so I can’t fetch the actual CNAME record IDs for `sample.com` with your key. However, here’s how you would normally do it:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/related?limit=100"
```

The response will contain a JSON object where each related item has an `"id"` field. Those are the IDs you’re looking for. If you run that command yourself, you’ll see something like:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {"id": "CNAME_1"},
    {"id": "CNAME_2"},
    ...
  ]
}
```

You can then extract just the `"id"` values (e.g., `CNAME_1`, `CNAME_2`, …) from the output.
